headline: The Events list endpoint has changed substantially since the 2026-09-08 capture: it now returns 7 upcoming events instead of 839 spanning 2007-2026, and compId is null on every one of them.

endpoints.role: the ONLY working way to read events - backs both fetchEvents() and fetchEvent()

shape.companies: [{ companyID, companyName, logoFileName, topLogoFileName, companyURL }] | null

expected.volume: 839 events (816 with publish="y"), 2007-11-18 to 2026-12-02. Response ~2.65 MB because each event repeats its organiser once per release (one ships the same company 167 times).
expected.pagination: pageSize honoured, default 10. Code sweeps PAGE_SIZE=500 across up to MAX_PAGES=20 and stops on a short page.
expected.caching: Deliberately NOT cached at the fetch() call site - the 2.65 MB response exceeds Next's 2 MB cache ceiling, so unstable_cache wraps the MAPPED result (~233 KB after deduping).

paginationBehaviour.conclusion: pageSize is no longer meaningful - the endpoint returns its whole (now tiny) result set on page 1. The default-of-10 trap recorded in PROJECT-CONTEXT.toon no longer applies.

endpoints.role: NOT USED - events.ts filters the list instead

expected.shape: The same AcnEvent object as a list row.

mismatches.expected: 839 events (816 published) spanning 2007-11-18 to 2026-12-02, swept over up to 20 pages of 500.
mismatches.actual: 7 events, all future-dated (2026-09-16 to 2026-12-02). Page 2 is empty. Confirmed across four different pageSize/pageNumber combinations.
mismatches.impact: The endpoint now appears to serve only current/upcoming events. Consequences: (a) /events lists 7 live rows plus the 4 curated mocks; (b) fetchEvent() resolves ONLY those 7 ids, so /events/<any historical id> now 404s - including every event id that was valid on 2026-09-08; (c) the PAGE_SIZE=500 / MAX_PAGES=20 sweep, the >2 MB cache-ceiling workaround and the unstable_cache-the-mapped-result design are all now sized for a payload that is 1,300x smaller.
mismatches.openQuestion: Is this an intentional backend change (upcoming-events-only) or data loss? Worth raising with the API team before reworking the sweep - the code is currently correct-but-oversized, which is the safe direction to be wrong in.

mismatches.expected: The organiser company id - "the key that relates an event to its releases". fetchEventReleases(compId, year) depends on it.
mismatches.impact: fetchEventReleases() returns [] immediately for every live event (its `if (!Number.isFinite(id) || id <= 0) return []` guard). Every API-backed event detail page therefore renders ZERO press releases. EV-RELEASES itself works fine (574/2026 returns 116 rows) - there is simply no longer any value to pass it.

mismatches.expected: An array of organiser companies, repeated once per release - mapEvent() dedupes by companyID, and that dedupe is the reason the mapped result fits in the cache.
mismatches.impact: Event.companies is always [] so LiveEvent.tsx shows no organiser. The dedupe logic in mapEvent() is now a no-op, as is the whole cache-the-mapped-result rationale.

mismatches.expected: Would return a single event; events.ts notes "Switch to /api/Events/{id} once the backend fixes that column."
mismatches.actual: STILL 500 on 2026-09-10, same EF Core Companies-column error as on 2026-09-07 and 2026-09-08. Three days further on with no fix.
mismatches.impact: The list-and-filter workaround in fetchEvent() is still required. Given E-M1, that workaround is now also what limits event detail pages to 7 ids.

mismatches.expected: Date-only midnights with no offset ("2009-07-16T00:00:00") - gap EVT-02, no opening time or timezone on any record.
mismatches.actual: CONFIRMED unchanged: "2026-09-16T00:00:00" on all 7 rows, no offset, no Z.
mismatches.impact: The +08:00 stamp toEventIso() applies is still needed, and is still a display-honesty patch over missing data rather than a fact from the API.

mismatches.expected: A "y"/"n" flag; loadEvents() filters to publish === "y" (816 of 839).
mismatches.actual: "y" on all 7 rows - the filter now removes nothing.
mismatches.impact: None. Keep the filter; it costs nothing and the field still exists.

mismatches.expected: A bare filename, prefixed to https://www.acnnewswire.com/eventimages/.
mismatches.impact: That host is still NOT whitelisted in next.config.ts, so next/image would reject these. Unchanged pre-existing gap.

mismatches.expected: The only event mapped in src/data/event-article-mappings.json, backing the orphan /events/<id>/press-releases route.
mismatches.impact: That route still resolves for its one mapped event. It remains orphaned - nothing links to it, because events.ts pins pressReleaseUrl to null.

verdict.endpointHealth: DEGRADED - EV-LIST returns 200 but a drastically reduced result set; EV-DETAIL still 500s; EV-RELEASES healthy but now unreachable in practice.
blockers: No live event can show its press releases (E-M2) - compId is null everywhere.
Historical event detail pages 404 (E-M1) - only 7 ids resolve.
verdict.unaffected: The 4 curated /events/<slug> mock pages are served entirely from src/data/mock-events.ts and are untouched by all of the above.
